name: Whistler
about: Winter is ski season; summer opens up hiking, mountain biking, and alpine lakes.
overview: North America's largest ski resort by lift-served terrain, with a genuine summer mountain-biking and hiking season too.
costOverview: A coffee or poutine barely registers — the lift ticket is the real daily expense, and it's a substantial one.
